steps.title: Prepare CSV file
steps.instruction: Save any .xlsx source file as a .csv and open it; the file contains rows for each source well with columns: concentration (ug/ml), yield (ug), Destination 1 volume (µL), Dilution concentration (ug/ml), Dilution yield (ug), Destination 2 volume (µL), and target well on the Norm Plate.

steps.title: Add water to Dil plates
steps.instruction: Transfer 90 µL of sterile water to every well of the LC Dil Plate and the HC Dil Plate.

steps.title: Add water to Norm plate
steps.instruction: According to the CSV, add the following water volumes to the Norm Plate wells: 81.82 µL to well F3, 80.00 µL to well G3, and 81.82 µL to well H3.

steps.title: Transfer LC DNA to Dil
steps.instruction: From the LC source plate, transfer 10 µL of DNA from each well to the matching well of the LC Dil Plate (e.g., A1 → A1, G3 → G3, H3 → H3). The source concentrations are 3000 µg/mL (A1, G3) and 3300 µg/mL (H3) with yields of 6.00 µg each.

steps.title: Transfer HC DNA to Dil
steps.instruction: From the HC source plate, transfer 10 µL of DNA from each well to the matching well of the HC Dil Plate (F3 → F3, G3 → G3, H3 → H3). All source concentrations are 3000 µg/mL with yields of 6.00 µg.

steps.title: Transfer LC DNA to Norm
steps.instruction: From the LC source plate, transfer DNA directly to the Norm Plate: 20 µL from wells A1 and G3, and 18.18 µL from well H3 (as listed in the CSV).

steps.title: Transfer HC DNA to Norm
steps.instruction: From the HC source plate, transfer DNA directly to the Norm Plate: 20 µL from wells F3, G3, and H3.

steps.title: Transfer LC Dil to Norm
steps.instruction: From the LC Dil Plate, transfer DNA to the Norm Plate: 20 µL from wells A1 and G3, and 18.18 µL from well H3 (matching the Destination 2 volumes in the CSV).

steps.title: Transfer HC Dil to Norm
steps.instruction: From the HC Dil Plate, transfer DNA to the Norm Plate: 20 µL from wells F3, G3, and H3.
